title: review follow-ups of PR #37591
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7196156631 on PR #37591, nit N2)

## What happens

PR #37591 (Part of #36029) adds a `{ systemPermission }` arm to a book's `audience`. That arm is strict, but the older `{ permissionSet }` arm is not. An audience written with both keys, `{ permissionSet: 'x', systemPermission: 'setup.access' }`, therefore parses as the `{ permissionSet }` arm, and `systemPermission` is dropped without a word. The author believes the book is gated on a capability, and it is gated on a permission set only.

- [ ] **Refuse the two-key shape.** Expected: `os lint` (or `os validate`) refuses an audience naming both keys and says which one to keep. Alternatively, make the `{ permissionSet }` arm strict under its own `(narrowing)` declaration, if a stored book with a stray key is shown not to exist.

Category ①: an authored value is accepted and silently means less than it says, on a permission surface.
Priority: p2. Nothing ships with the two-key shape today, and the new arm is days old.
Business reason: an admin manual gated by a mistyped audience opens to a wider or different group than its author intended.
Reader: the lane that holds `packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts` and `packages/lint` (seat 2 s2-data, after #36029's code PR lands).
Dedupe: `book audience permissionSet systemPermission strict` (open issues), 0 hits besides #36029.
Related: #36029, PR #37591.
